authority_model.A: Authoritative hard requirement (user-declared non-negotiable or binding authoritative constraint)
authority_model.B: Validated professional rule (strong professional guidance, not automatic MUST unless independently hard)

outcome_validation: Real-world outcome methodology with traceable cohort and metrics
constraints: Internal review alone cannot upgrade unsupported rules to Level A/B
AI cannot validate its own professional rule

level_d_restrictions: Cannot materially rank as professionally validated

rules.name: User non-negotiable budget hard gate
rules.description: When user explicitly marks budget as mandatory, facilities over mandatory budget are hard excluded.
rules.trigger_input: Questionnaire notes contains strict/hard mandatory budget terms
rules.interpretation: Budget is a declared MUST, not a soft preference.
rules.decision_effect: Hard exclusion on mandatory budget breach
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Explicit user signal
rules.notes: Complies with MUST boundary because origin is explicit user non-negotiable.

rules.name: User non-negotiable distance hard gate
rules.description: When user explicitly marks distance/location as mandatory, out-of-range communities are hard excluded.
rules.trigger_input: Questionnaire notes and distance profile marked mandatory
rules.interpretation: Geography is a declared MUST for this case.
rules.decision_effect: Hard exclusion on mandatory geography mismatch
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Explicit user signal
rules.notes: Complies with MUST boundary because origin is explicit user non-negotiable.

rules.name: User non-negotiable language hard gate
rules.description: When language is mandatory per user language profile, facilities without clear support are hard excluded.
rules.trigger_input: Preferred spoken language + bilingual/familiar language required flags
rules.interpretation: Language continuity is mandatory.
rules.decision_effect: Hard exclusion on mandatory language mismatch
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Explicit user signal
rules.notes: Complies with MUST boundary because origin is explicit user non-negotiable.

rules.name: Required care-level compatibility gate
rules.description: Facilities must support required care level derived from user-declared assistance/memory/future-care profile.
rules.interpretation: Unsafe or incompatible care-level mismatch is non-eligible.
rules.decision_effect: Hard exclusion when required care type is unsupported
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Safety-critical, source trace present
rules.notes: Must remain traceable to explicit care requirements and safety rationale.

rules.name: Critical clinical capability absence gate
rules.description: Critical clinical requirements evaluated as NO produce hard exclusion.
rules.trigger_input: Clinical capability assessment states for CRITICAL requirements
rules.interpretation: Missing critical capability creates unacceptable care risk.
rules.source_reference: 42 CFR Part 483 quality of care and nursing service obligations; frontend/src/lib/optime-v2-engine.ts::buildClinicalRequirements + assessClinicalCapability + critical NO hard rejection
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Safety-critical, external verification pending
rules.notes: Governance requires ongoing external review of each CRITICAL requirement mapping.

rules.name: Clinical requirement extraction from questionnaire
rules.description: Transforms user signals and notes into structured clinical/lifestyle/social/future-care requirements.
rules.interpretation: Map raw user statements to care capability checks.
rules.decision_effect: Generates requirement checklist and verification questions
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Rule extraction works mechanically; professional mapping review pending
rules.notes: No automatic MUST allowed from this rule alone.

rules.name: Facility capability assessment with memory-first evidence
rules.description: Uses verified facility memory when available; otherwise evaluates capability from facility text/taxonomy.
rules.trigger_input: Requirement key + facility evidence text + persisted verification memory
rules.interpretation: Prefer verified evidence over inferred metadata cues
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Verified evidence preferred; heuristic fallback present
rules.notes: Fallback text heuristics are evidence-limited and must stay transparent.

rules.name: Recommendation knowledge guard
rules.description: Backend guard uses freshness/health/verification/confidence policy to use or skip agent knowledge in recommendations.
rules.trigger_input: Agent report snapshot freshness, confidence, verified_until, health
rules.interpretation: Prepared knowledge can only influence decisions when policy allows.
rules.decision_effect: USED or SKIPPED decision with trace log
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Traceable policy decision with persisted logs
rules.notes: Supports anti-hallucination by skipping unverified/stale knowledge.

rules.name: Evidence source tier classification
rules.description: Assigns source tiers for evidence traceability and confidence weighting.
rules.interpretation: Higher-authority source tiers should carry higher baseline confidence.
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Traceable tier logic; calibration review pending
rules.notes: Used for confidence and traceability, not direct hard exclusion.

rules.name: Claim freshness classification
rules.description: Classifies claims as CURRENT/AGING/STALE/UNKNOWN based on claim type and dates.
rules.interpretation: Different claim domains have different freshness windows.
rules.decision_effect: Freshness status impacts confidence and recommendation usage
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Traceable freshness logic
rules.notes: Unknown freshness must not be treated as PASS.

rules.name: Claim confidence calculation
rules.description: Computes claim confidence from source tier, source count, conflict status, freshness.
rules.trigger_input: source tier + freshness + conflict + source count
rules.interpretation: Confidence must degrade when stale/conflicting and increase with corroboration.
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Traceable confidence calculus
rules.notes: Calibrated confidence, not a hard exclusion rule.

rules.name: Preference bonus from preference YES states
rules.description: Preference YES counts influence ranking order as tie/bonus, not eligibility.
rules.interpretation: Preference alignment improves ranking but should not hard-exclude.
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Preference signal with limited external validation
rules.notes: Complies with no hard exclusion for Level C.

rules.name: Family-fit tie-break in accepted ranking
rules.description: When primary score ties, family/clinical tie-breakers decide order.
rules.trigger_input: Equal total score among accepted recommendations
rules.interpretation: Tie should be resolved using transparent, lower-impact signals.
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Operational tie-break, external outcome proof pending
rules.notes: No direct hard exclusion; applies only after eligibility.

rules.name: Fallback ranking when accepted set is empty
rules.description: If no accepted recommendations exist, fallback ranking uses evidence-completeness and fit blend.
rules.interpretation: Show best available options with explicit tradeoffs instead of empty output.
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Transparent fallback behavior with uncertainty surfaced
rules.notes: Supports user continuity while preserving uncertainty exposure.

rules.name: Distance band scoring
rules.description: Distance inputs are converted into banded family-fit adjustments.
rules.interpretation: Travel burden influences fit as contextual preference.
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Heuristic contextual mapping; external validation pending
rules.notes: Can affect ranking; should stay transparent and non-authoritative.

rules.name: Future-care preference ranking adjustment
rules.description: Future-care preference modifies ranking through bounded adjustments and explanations.
rules.interpretation: Future progression preference shapes recommendation order.
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Preference logic with transparent rationale
rules.notes: Independent-only preference can generate rejection reasons inside this function but hard exclusion is enforced by dedicated MUST rules.

rules.name: UNKNOWN affects confidence only
rules.description: Unknown capability states are excluded from match score and only lower confidence/readiness.
rules.interpretation: No evidence cannot be silently converted into negative professional claim.
rules.decision_effect: Confidence reduction + verification task generation; no automatic negative score impact
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Explicitly traceable in runtime formula
rules.notes: Core anti-hallucination behavior for unknown capability evidence.

rules.name: Persona weight profile table
rules.description: Static persona-to-weight map with fixed percentages across fit dimensions.
rules.interpretation: Applies heuristic weighting profile by persona
rules.decision_effect: Affects explanations/audit fields and potential ranking pathways
rules.confidence_evidence_status: No external professional validation for these specific weight values
rules.notes: Cannot be represented as professionally validated rule.

rules.name: Understanding domain weight schema
rules.description: Static domain weights for understanding score and recommendation confidence.
rules.interpretation: Heuristic weighting for profile readiness
rules.confidence_evidence_status: No external professional validation for fixed domain weights
rules.notes: Operational metric only, not professional recommendation authority.

rules.name: Understanding critical-penalty multipliers
rules.description: Fixed multipliers for missing critical domains in understanding score.
rules.interpretation: Heuristic severity curve for incompleteness
rules.confidence_evidence_status: No external validation for selected multipliers
rules.notes: Must not be promoted as professional clinical rule.

rules.name: Intelligence overlay capping heuristics
rules.description: Hard caps and provenance-specific deltas for social/family/cultural/reputation/staff/regulatory overlays.
rules.interpretation: Bounded heuristic overlay of external signals
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Heuristic calibrations; external evidence mapping incomplete
rules.notes: Material score modifiers must remain marked unvalidated until external calibration evidence exists.

rules.name: Distance-to-points step function
rules.description: Discrete point bands for drive-time values.
rules.interpretation: Heuristic translation of travel time to score points
rules.confidence_evidence_status: No external published calibration in repository
rules.notes: Keep transparent as heuristic-only.

rules.name: Benchmark advisor rescoring multipliers
rules.description: Synthetic benchmark script applies fixed multipliers/bonuses/penalties for advisor simulation.
rules.trigger_input: Benchmark persona priorities and care-type preferences
rules.interpretation: Simulation-only advisor proxy logic
rules.confidence_evidence_status: Synthetic mechanics only, not professional rule validation
rules.notes: Cannot be used as professional validation evidence.
